attribution.note1: B1 churn (4-8 rows/edge) is the DELTA per move; the fresh path re-adds ALL ~24 active rows per eval.
attribution.note2: FT row adds dominate: scan+dummyft 19.3us vs scan 7.4us — ~12us is row-add memory traffic (relation rows span 1.9MB of ft_weights; ~24 random 256B rows x 2 perspectives = cache misses), not attack queries.
attribution.note3: edge+eval on simple playout positions is 3.8x E3 (5.1us vs 1.34us); corpus eval-only is ~22x (22.8us vs 1.06us). Search NPS lands at 0.58 median — between the two, since search mixes simple qsearch leaves with complex middlegame nodes.

verdict: Fresh-recompute hybrid pays a large eval tax. NPS 0.58 < 0.80 gate: per the frozen protocol, B5 is PAUSED; the decision is whether an incremental relation updater (avg 4-8 rows/edge churn, B1) is engineering-justified.
